scientific_integrity: All-size/all-step proof by orthogonal spectral projectors and an exact quadratic sign. Finite exact-rational replay is supplementary only.
scientific_limitations: Exactly weighted complete networks with pairwise disjoint exceptional edges; this is a completed linear graph-heat step, not an RK stage or nonlinear positivity claim. Priority not independently certified.
title: Sharp Gauss–Legendre positivity on complete networks with an exceptional matching
